root_cause: Commit 831a1514843bfa4d4d006627 (urlapi: consume trailing dots after IPv4 numerical addresses) replaced the previous unconditional 'if(rc) return HOST_NAME;' check after the number-parsing dispatch with a conditional that allows a failed parse to be tolerated when n is nonzero, rc == STRE_NO_NUM, and the cursor is at the end of the string -- intending to permit a trailing dot after the last IPv4 octet to be silently dropped. However this same lenient path is also reachable when the component begins with the '0x' prefix (handled by curlx_str_hex) but contains no hex digits at all, because curlx_str_hex also returns STRE_NO_NUM and leaves the cursor at end-of-string in that scenario. The code did not special-case the hex-prefix branch to reject rc failures immediately, so a hex-prefixed-but-empty terminal component is misclassified as the 'trailing dot was swallowed' case.
findings: ipv4_normalize() was changed to tolerate a failing numeric-parse (rc != 0) as a 'trailing dot was swallowed' case whenever the prior component index n is nonzero, the failure code is STRE_NO_NUM, and the cursor c now points at the string terminator.
